extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors (especially new users attempting to create a page)
extracted.subtask_description: Practical guidance for contributors on steps, prerequisites, and checks to take when a requested Wikipedia article title does not exist (or appears deleted/not visible). Covers account requirements, searching for existing content, redirects, and deletion logs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles/alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for Comedy Bang Bang TV in Wikipedia to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search for "Comedy Bang Bang TV" in existing articles. Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create pages
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or not autoconfirmed you cannot create a new article under this title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request/create a draft
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the page directly (e.g., not autoconfirmed), use the article wizard to submit a draft for community review or follow the 'request a new article' process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to the title (backlinks)
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigate existing pages that reference the title to find mentions, context, or possible redirects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay and purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you or someone recently created the page and it doesn't appear, wait briefly for the database to update or use the purge function to refresh the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Case sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify alternative capitalizations of the title and, if appropriate, create a redirect from the non-canonical capitalization to the correct page title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if the page was removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examine the deletion log to determine whether the page was removed and read the provided rationale; follow deletion guidance or salvage content via appropriate processes (e.g., discuss on talk pages or request undeletion).
